sections.title: Passage A - Ding Chen's Invention
raw_text: Ding Chen is 13 years old and he is from Anhui Province.
He is 1. ________ average middle school student, but he is famous in his hometown.
Lots of people know him because of his great invention.
Several years ago, Ding Chen wanted to invent something for his grandparents.
His grandparents lived in an old building without elevators.
They 2. ________ (have) to climb stairs every day.
It became even 3. ________ (hard) than before after his grandfather fell ill.
It was then that Ding Chen had a dream.
He dreamed of inventing something that could help his grandparents climb stairs more 4. ________ (easy).
Three years later, Ding Chen's dream came true.
He solved the problem and a booster(助力器) 5. ________ (invent) by him.
The booster is very 6. ________ (use) and it can help the old people walk up stairs.
To his excitement, the booster helped him to win an international invention award.
He felt very excited 7. ________ he won the award.
His parents and teachers were proud 8. ________ him.
All his classmates said that Ding Chen was their pride.
In the future, Ding Chen wants to make some 9. ________ (improve) to his invention.
He also plans to apply for a patent(专利) on his invention.
If possible, he wants to find some companies 10. ________ (produce) it.
"I hope all the people in need can benefit from(受益于) it," he said.

questions.explanation: average 以元音音素开头，且此处表示泛指'一名普通的中学生'，故填不定冠词 an。
questions.rule_summary: 元音音素开头的单数可数名词前泛指用 an。

questions.explanation: 根据前文 lived 及 Several years ago 可知为过去发生的事，have to 用过去式 had to。
questions.rule_summary: 根据上下文时态标志词和主句时态保持一般过去时一致。

questions.explanation: 空后有比较标志词 than，且空前有 even 修饰比较级，故填 harder。
questions.rule_summary: even/much/than 明确提示形容词比较级。

questions.explanation: 修饰动词短语 climb stairs 需要用副词 easily，more easily 构成副词比较级。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰动词需用形容词派生的副词形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般过去时的被动语态
questions.explanation: 主语 a booster 与 invent 是被动关系，且发生在过去，由 by him 提示，故用 was invented。
questions.rule_summary: 单数主语 + 过去发生 + by 动作执行者 = was done。

questions.grammar_point_name: 词性转换：动词变形容词
questions.explanation: 系动词 is 和副词 very 后需要填形容词作表语，根据句意'非常有用'故填 useful。
questions.rule_summary: is very + adj.，根据语境由动词转化为形容词 useful。

questions.grammar_point_name: 时间/原因状语从句从属连词
questions.explanation: 引导时间状语从句表示'当他获奖时'用连词 when（或 because 表原因）。
questions.rule_summary: 连接主从复合句，表示时间用 when。

questions.explanation: 固定短语 be proud of sb. 意为'为某人感到自豪'，故填介词 of。
questions.rule_summary: 固定搭配 be proud of。

questions.explanation: make improvements to 意为'对……做出改进'，some 后接可数名词复数 improvements。
questions.rule_summary: some + 动词派生名词复数。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：动词不定式作定语/目的状语
questions.explanation: find companies to do sth. 动词不定式作后置定语，表示'生产它的公司'。
questions.rule_summary: 动词不定式 to do 作名词后置定语或目的状语。

filled_text: Ding Chen is 13 years old and he is from Anhui Province.
He is an average middle school student, but he is famous in his hometown.
Lots of people know him because of his great invention.
Several years ago, Ding Chen wanted to invent something for his grandparents.
His grandparents lived in an old building without elevators.
They had to climb stairs every day.
It became even harder than before after his grandfather fell ill.
It was then that Ding Chen had a dream.
He dreamed of inventing something that could help his grandparents climb stairs more easily.
Three years later, Ding Chen's dream came true.
He solved the problem and a booster was invented by him.
The booster is very useful and it can help the old people walk up stairs.
To his excitement, the booster helped him to win an international invention award.
He felt very excited when he won the award.
His parents and teachers were proud of him.
All his classmates said that Ding Chen was their pride.
In the future, Ding Chen wants to make some improvements to his invention.
He also plans to apply for a patent on his invention.
If possible, he wants to find some companies to produce it.
"I hope all the people in need can benefit from it," he said.
filled_text_cn: 丁晨今年13岁，来自安徽省。
他是一名普通的中学生，但在他的家乡很有名。
很多人因为他的伟大发明而认识他。
几年前，丁晨想为他的祖父母发明一些东西。
他的祖父母住在没有电梯的老旧居民楼里。
他们每天都不得不爬楼梯。
自从他的祖爷爷生病后，这变得比以前更艰难了。
正是在那时，丁晨有了一个梦想。
他梦想着发明一种能帮祖父母更轻松爬楼梯的东西。
三年后，丁晨的梦想成真了。
他解决了这个问题，并发明了一种助力器。
这个助力器非常实用，能帮助老人们走楼梯。
令他兴奋的是，这个助力器帮他赢得了一个国际发明奖。
当他获奖时，他感到非常激动。
他的父母和老师都为他感到骄傲。
他所有的同班同学都说丁晨是他们的骄傲。
未来，丁晨想要对他的发明进行一些改进。
他还计划为自己的发明申请专利。
如果可能的话，他想找一些公司来生产它。
“我希望所有需要帮助的人都能从中受益，”他说。

sections.title: Passage B - Origin of 'Shangdangle'
raw_text: Why do we say someone *shangdangle* when he or she has been cheated?
*Dang* here 1. ________ (stand) for "pawnshop(当铺)".
A pawnshop is a store where people can sell their things to 2. ________ shopkeeper.
The shopkeeper can then sell their things to others.
But what do pawnshops have to do with cheating?
A story goes that during the Qing Dynasty, there was a rich family that owned a pawnshop.
However, they were not good 3. ________ running it, so they asked a young man named Shou Zhu to help.
Shou loved reading.
He spent too much time 4. ________ (read) books and cared little about the business.
Some people noticed this.
They took lots of useless things to the shop and sold 5. ________ (they) to Shou at a high price.
Shou, however, didn't realize he was being cheated.
Soon, the pawnshop ran out of money 6. ________ had to close.
From then on, "going to the pawnshop" became another way of saying someone 7. ________ (cheat).
There are other 8. ________ (story) about it.
For example, in ancient China, when poor people sold their things to pawnshops, they usually got a very low price.
9. ________ (fair) trade was quite common.
So 10. ________ (gradual) people came to say that someone "went to the pawnshop" when he or she was cheated.

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般现在时（主谓一致第三人称单数）
questions.explanation: 陈述客观事实用一般现在时，主语 Dang 是单数，stand 用第三人称单数 stands。
questions.rule_summary: 客观解释 + 单数主语 = 谓语动词三单形式。

questions.explanation: 特指当铺的店主，且下句继续出现 The shopkeeper，故填定冠词 the。
questions.rule_summary: 特定语境特指该店的店主用 the。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配 (be good at)
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 be good at sth./doing sth. 意为'擅长做某事'，故填 at。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 be good at doing。

questions.explanation: 固定句型 spend time (in) doing sth. 花费时间做某事，接动名词 reading。
questions.rule_summary: spend time doing sth. 动名词句型。

questions.explanation: 作为动词 sold 的宾语，代指 useless things，需用人称代词宾格 them。
questions.rule_summary: 动词后作宾语用代词宾格。

questions.explanation: ran out of money 与 had to close 是顺承顺接关系，用并列连词 and 连接。
questions.rule_summary: 并列动作顺承关系用 and。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般过去时的被动语态
questions.explanation: someone 与 cheat 之间是被动关系（某人被骗），且主句 became 为过去时，故用 was cheated。
questions.rule_summary: 过去语境中的单数被动语态 was done。

questions.explanation: There are 及 other 修饰可数名词复数，story 的复数形式变 y 为 i 再加 es -> stories。
questions.rule_summary: there are + other + 名词复数。

questions.grammar_point_name: 派生词：加否定前缀 un-
questions.explanation: 根据前文'穷人只能卖很低的价格'可知是不公平的交易，修饰名词 trade 用形容词 Unfair（首字母大写）。
questions.rule_summary: 根据上下文否定逻辑加前缀 un-，作定语用形容词。

questions.explanation: 修饰整个句子或动词短语 came to say，用副词 gradually 表示'逐渐地'。
questions.rule_summary: 句首修饰动作/全句用副词。

filled_text: Why do we say someone *shangdangle* when he or she has been cheated?
*Dang* here stands for "pawnshop".
A pawnshop is a store where people can sell their things to the shopkeeper.
The shopkeeper can then sell their things to others.
But what do pawnshops have to do with cheating?
A story goes that during the Qing Dynasty, there was a rich family that owned a pawnshop.
However, they were not good at running it, so they asked a young man named Shou Zhu to help.
Shou loved reading.
He spent too much time reading books and cared little about the business.
Some people noticed this.
They took lots of useless things to the shop and sold them to Shou at a high price.
Shou, however, didn't realize he was being cheated.
Soon, the pawnshop ran out of money and had to close.
From then on, "going to the pawnshop" became another way of saying someone was cheated.
There are other stories about it.
For example, in ancient China, when poor people sold their things to pawnshops, they usually got a very low price.
Unfair trade was quite common.
So gradually people came to say that someone "went to the pawnshop" when he or she was cheated.
filled_text_cn: 为什么当一个人被骗时，我们会说他“上当了”呢？
这里的“当”代表“当铺”。
当铺是一种人们可以把物品卖给掌柜的店铺。
然后掌柜的可以把这些物品卖给其他人。
但是当铺和受骗有什么关系呢？
据说在清朝时期，有一个富裕的人家开了一家当铺。
然而，他们并不擅长经营，于是请了一个名叫寿柱的年轻人来帮忙。
寿柱酷爱读书。
他把太多时间花在看书上，对生意却漠不关心。
有些人注意到了这一点。
他们把许多没用的东西拿到店里，以高价卖给了寿柱。
然而，寿柱却没有意识到自己被骗了。
很快，当铺就花光了所有的钱，不得不关门大吉。
从那时起，“去当铺”就成了形容某人被骗的另一种说法。
关于这个词还有其他的传说。
例如，在古代中国，当穷人把东西卖给当铺时，他们通常只能得到很低的价格。
不公平的买卖相当普遍。
所以渐渐地，当一个人被骗时，人们就开始说他“进了当铺”。

sections.title: Passage C - Sage of Art Wu Daozi
raw_text: Wu Daozi was one of the greatest of all Chinese artists.
He was well-known for 1. ________ (he) own way of painting with excellent skills.
Wu 2. ________ (lose) his parents when he was a young child and he lived a very poor life.
The young Wu had to work very hard 3. ________ (make) a living.
He began to learn painting not from famous painters at that time, 4. ________ from folk artisans(民间手艺人) in today's Henan Province.
In order to learn how to paint landscapes (风景), Wu followed a great 5. ________ (paint) and he travelled to many places with 6. ________ (mountain) and rivers.
After three years of learning, he created the so-called *shuti* of landscape painting.
Also, he became the 7. ________ (one) artist in Chinese art history to turn landscapes 8. ________ a new kind of painting.
Besides landscapes, Wu also learned a lot in painting human figures.
He was 9. ________ (especial) good at it and developed his special painting skills.
During his lifetime, Wu painted more than 300 amazing murals(壁画).
No wonder he 10. ________ (consider) as a "Sage of Art"(画圣) in China.

questions.explanation: one's own way 意为'某人自己的方式'，需填形容词性物主代词 his。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词短语用形容词性物主代词 his。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般过去时（不规则动词变化）
questions.explanation: 由 when he was a young child 可知描述过去经历，lose 的过去式为 lost。
questions.rule_summary: 过去时间从句对应主句一般过去时。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式作目的状语
questions.explanation: work hard to make a living 意为'努力工作以维持生计'，不定式 to make 作目的状语。
questions.rule_summary: 不定式 to do 表目的。

questions.explanation: 固定结构 not...but... 意为'不是……而是……'，故填 but。
questions.rule_summary: 固定连词搭配 not...but...。

questions.explanation: a great 后接指人的单数名词，paint 派生为 painter（画家）。
questions.rule_summary: 冠词 + 形容词 + 职业/人物名词 (painter)。

questions.explanation: 与复数名词 rivers 并列，表示'有山有水的地方'，mountain 用复数 mountains。
questions.rule_summary: 并列结构一致性与名词复数。

questions.explanation: the + 序数词 + 单数名词，表示'第一位艺术家'，one 的序数词是 first。
questions.rule_summary: the + 序数词 first。

questions.explanation: 动词短语 turn...into... 意为'把……变成……'，故填介词 into。
questions.rule_summary: 固定动介搭配 turn...into...

questions.explanation: 修饰形容词短语 good at 需用副词 especially 意为'尤其，特别'。
questions.rule_summary: 副词修饰形容词结构 adv. + adj.

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般现在时的被动语态
questions.explanation: 主语 he 与 consider 是被动关系，且陈述目前人们普遍公认的事实，用一般现在时被动语态 is considered。
questions.rule_summary: 客观共识 + 单数被动 = is considered as。

filled_text: Wu Daozi was one of the greatest of all Chinese artists.
He was well-known for his own way of painting with excellent skills.
Wu lost his parents when he was a young child and he lived a very poor life.
The young Wu had to work very hard to make a living.
He began to learn painting not from famous painters at that time, but from folk artisans in today's Henan Province.
In order to learn how to paint landscapes, Wu followed a great painter and he travelled to many places with mountains and rivers.
After three years of learning, he created the so-called *shuti* of landscape painting.
Also, he became the first artist in Chinese art history to turn landscapes into a new kind of painting.
Besides landscapes, Wu also learned a lot in painting human figures.
He was especially good at it and developed his special painting skills.
During his lifetime, Wu painted more than 300 amazing murals.
No wonder he is considered as a "Sage of Art" in China.
filled_text_cn: 吴道子是中国历史上最伟大的艺术家之一。
他以独特的绘画方式和精湛的技艺而闻名。
吴道子幼年丧失双亲，过着非常贫困的生活。
年轻的吴道子为了谋生不得不非常努力地工作。
他开始学画并非向当时的名家拜师，而是向如今河南省的民间手艺人学习。
为了学习如何画风景，吴道子跟随一位绘画大师，游历了许多有山有水的地方。
经过三年的学习，他开创了山水画所谓的“蜀体”。
此外，他成为了中国美术史上第一个将山水画变成全新画种的艺术家。
除了山水画，吴道子在人物画方面也学到了很多。
他尤其擅长人物画，并发展出了自己特殊的绘画技巧。
在他的一生中，吴道子创作了300多幅令人惊叹的壁画。
难怪他在中国被尊为“画圣”。

sections.title: Passage D - Milk Tea Meets TCM
raw_text: The old saying "good medicine tastes bitter(苦的)" may no longer be true in China.
Feeling tired, a 20-year-old college student named Xi Linjie went to a Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) hospital in Chongqing.
To her surprise, she 1. ________ (get) a cup of sweet milk tea instead of medicine.
2. ________ tea was both delicious and healthy.
This special milk tea 3. ________ (make) by the hospital's nutrition (营养) team.
They mix old Chinese medicine with modern food.
"Milk tea is popular among young people.
We hope it can be a bridge for them to increase knowledge of TCM and to accept TCM," said Liao Changying, director of the team.
She said that almost every person would like 4. ________ (share) the special experience with their family and friends after trying the milk tea.
5. ________ the help of modern technology, the hospital makes the tea taste better.
For example, they use rose oil instead of rose petals(花瓣) to make it less bitter.
Besides, the hospital also tries to make candies, cakes 6. ________ other products with TCM.
"7. ________ (we) goal is to help people prevent and cure(预防与治疗) diseases while they are enjoying delicious food and drinks," Liao explained.
In Chongqing, there is also a TCM night market, which is held every weekend.
People can 8. ________ (easy) get the health service there.
"TCM is much 9. ________ (close) to our daily lives than before," a man said.
Over half of the 10. ________ (visitor) are young people who come to ask for professional advice.
It shows that the younger ones are more and more confident of TCM nowadays.

questions.explanation: 由前文 went to 可知叙述当时去医院的经历，用一般过去时 got。
questions.rule_summary: 主句叙述过去事件保持过去时一致。

questions.explanation: 特指上文提到的一杯甜奶茶 (a cup of sweet milk tea)，再次提及用定冠词 The（首字母大写）。
questions.rule_summary: 特指上文已提及的人或物用 the。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般现在时的被动语态
questions.explanation: 陈述这款奶茶日常的制作团队与事实，由 by 提示被动语态，单数主语用 is made。
questions.rule_summary: 客观属性/生产介绍 + by 提示 = 一般现在时被动语态 is made。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：would like to do
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 would like to do sth. 意为'想要/愿意做某事'，接不定式 to share。
questions.rule_summary: would like to do 动词不定式搭配。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定短语 (with the help of)
questions.explanation: 固定介词短语 with the help of... 意为'在……的帮助下'，句首首字母大写 With。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 with the help of。

questions.explanation: candies, cakes 与 other products 为并列列举关系，故填并列连词 and。
questions.rule_summary: A, B and C 并列列举结构。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词 goal 意为'我们的目标'，需用形容词性物主代词 Our（首字母大写）。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词用形容词性物主代词 Our。

questions.explanation: 修饰动词短语 get the health service 需用副词 easily 意为'容易地'。
questions.rule_summary: 副词修饰动词 can + adv. + v.

questions.explanation: 句中有比较标志词 than before，且空前有 much 修饰比较级，故填 closer。
questions.rule_summary: much + 比较级 + than。

questions.explanation: 由谓语动词 are 可知主语为复数概念，over half of the visitors（半数以上的游客）。
questions.rule_summary: half of the + 复数名词 + are。

filled_text: The old saying "good medicine tastes bitter" may no longer be true in China.
Feeling tired, a 20-year-old college student named Xi Linjie went to a Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) hospital in Chongqing.
To her surprise, she got a cup of sweet milk tea instead of medicine.
The tea was both delicious and healthy.
This special milk tea is made by the hospital's nutrition team.
They mix old Chinese medicine with modern food.
"Milk tea is popular among young people.
We hope it can be a bridge for them to increase knowledge of TCM and to accept TCM," said Liao Changying, director of the team.
She said that almost every person would like to share the special experience with their family and friends after trying the milk tea.
With the help of modern technology, the hospital makes the tea taste better.
For example, they use rose oil instead of rose petals to make it less bitter.
Besides, the hospital also tries to make candies, cakes and other products with TCM.
"Our goal is to help people prevent and cure diseases while they are enjoying delicious food and drinks," Liao explained.
In Chongqing, there is also a TCM night market, which is held every weekend.
People can easily get the health service there.
"TCM is much closer to our daily lives than before," a man said.
Over half of the visitors are young people who come to ask for professional advice.
It shows that the younger ones are more and more confident of TCM nowadays.
filled_text_cn: “良药苦口”这句老话在中国可能已经不再那么适用了。
20岁的大学生席林洁（音译）觉得很累，便去了重庆的一家中医医院。
令她惊讶的是，她拿到的是一杯甜甜的奶茶，而不是药。
这款奶茶既美味又健康。
这种特殊的奶茶是由该医院的营养团队制作的。
他们将古老的中医药与现代食品融合在一起。
“奶茶在年轻人中很受欢迎。
我们希望它能成为年轻人增加中医知识并接受中医的一座桥梁，”该团队负责人廖长颖（音译）说道。
她说，几乎每个人在尝试了这款奶茶后，都愿意与家人和朋友分享这种特别的体验。
在现代科技的帮助下，医院让奶茶的味道变得更好。
例如，他们用玫瑰精油代替玫瑰花瓣来降低苦味。
此外，该医院还尝试用中药制作糖果、蛋糕和其他产品。
“我们的目标是帮助人们在享受美味食物和饮品的同时预防和治疗疾病，”廖解释道。
在重庆，还有一个中医药夜市，于每个周末举办。
人们在那里可以很轻松地获得医疗保健服务。
“中医比以前更贴近我们的日常生活了，”一位男子说道。
过半的游客都是前来寻求专业建议的年轻人。
这表明如今的年轻人对中医越来越自信了。

sections.title: Passage E - Ms Wu's Cultural Teahouse
raw_text: On Pingjiang Road in Suzhou, 65-year-old Ms Wu has run a traditional teahouse for 30 years.
She never expected 1. ________ (her) to become a tea master who helped build a cultural bridge.
It started in 2015 when a German tourist named Klaus walked into her shop.
With the help of a phone app, Ms Wu 2. ________ (patient) showed him the way to properly brew(沏) Biluochun, Suzhou's famous green tea.
Klaus returned every day that week and 3. ________ (bring) more friends each time.
Seeing how 4. ________ (interest) they were in Chinese tea, Ms Wu started a weekly activity called "Tea Culture Saturdays".
She showed foreigners 5. ________ to brew tea with traditional methods from choosing the water temperature to 6. ________ (follow) tea-making rules.
Her daughter Lily, a college student, helped translate.
Soon, her teahouse was always crowded with 7. ________ (visit), including students and business people from many places.
"I used to think foreigners wouldn't understand our tea culture, 8. ________ they love it deeply.
Some of them even treat their friends with Chinese tea at home," Ms Wu said.
One of her favourite 9. ________ (moment) was when Sarah, a Canadian, gave her a notebook filled with tea notes written in both English and Chinese.
"This is why I keep teaching," Ms Wu said, showing 10. ________ treasured notebook.
Now, her teahouse appears in travel guides as "Suzhou's cultural living room".
For tourists, every cup of tea served is a window on the tea culture of this ancient city.

questions.explanation: 主语 She 与动作承受者是同一人，expect oneself to do 表示'料想自己会……'，用反身代词 herself。
questions.rule_summary: 主语与宾语同一人时用反身代词。

questions.explanation: 修饰动词 showed 需用副词 patiently 意为'耐心地'。
questions.rule_summary: 副词修饰动词结构 adv. + v.

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般过去时（不规则变化）
questions.explanation: and 连接并列谓语，与 returned 保持一致，bring 的过去式为 brought。
questions.rule_summary: and 连接两个过去时并列谓语动词。

questions.explanation: 固定短语 be interested in 意为'对……感兴趣'，修饰人 (they) 用 interested。
questions.rule_summary: how + adj. + 主语 + be，修饰人对某物感兴趣用 interested。

questions.grammar_point_name: 疑问词 + 不定式结构 (how to do)
questions.explanation: show sb. how to do sth. 意为'向某人展示如何做某事'，故填疑问副词 how。
questions.rule_summary: show sb. how to do sth. 结构。

questions.explanation: from...to... 中 to 是介词，与 choosing 并列，需用动名词 following。
questions.rule_summary: 介词 to 后接动名词 -ing。

questions.grammar_point_name: 动词派生指人的名词复数
questions.explanation: be crowded with 挤满了……，后接指人的复数名词 visitors（包括学生与商务人士）。
questions.rule_summary: be crowded with + 复数名词 (visitors)。

questions.explanation: 前文'以为不懂'与后文'深深热爱'构成明显转折对比关系，故填 but。
questions.rule_summary: 前后句转折对比用 but。

questions.grammar_point_name: 可数名词复数 (one of the + 复数)
questions.explanation: one of + 形容词最高级/形容词 + 名词复数，意为'最……之一'，故填 moments。
questions.rule_summary: one of her favourite + 名词复数。

questions.explanation: 特指前文提到的 Sarah 赠送的那本笔记本 (a notebook filled with tea notes)，故填定冠词 the。
questions.rule_summary: 特指前文已经出现过的事物用 the。

filled_text: On Pingjiang Road in Suzhou, 65-year-old Ms Wu has run a traditional teahouse for 30 years.
She never expected herself to become a tea master who helped build a cultural bridge.
It started in 2015 when a German tourist named Klaus walked into her shop.
With the help of a phone app, Ms Wu patiently showed him the way to properly brew Biluochun, Suzhou's famous green tea.
Klaus returned every day that week and brought more friends each time.
Seeing how interested they were in Chinese tea, Ms Wu started a weekly activity called "Tea Culture Saturdays".
She showed foreigners how to brew tea with traditional methods from choosing the water temperature to following tea-making rules.
Her daughter Lily, a college student, helped translate.
Soon, her teahouse was always crowded with visitors, including students and business people from many places.
"I used to think foreigners wouldn't understand our tea culture, but they love it deeply.
Some of them even treat their friends with Chinese tea at home," Ms Wu said.
One of her favourite moments was when Sarah, a Canadian, gave her a notebook filled with tea notes written in both English and Chinese.
"This is why I keep teaching," Ms Wu said, showing the treasured notebook.
Now, her teahouse appears in travel guides as "Suzhou's cultural living room".
For tourists, every cup of tea served is a window on the tea culture of this ancient city.
filled_text_cn: 在苏州的平江路，65岁的吴女士经营着一家传统茶馆已有30年。
她从未想到自己会成为一名搭建文化桥梁的茶艺大师。
这一切始于2015年，当时一位名叫克劳斯的德国游客走进了她的店。
借助手机软件的帮助，吴女士耐心地向他展示了如何正确冲泡苏州名绿茶——碧螺春的方法。
那一周里，克劳斯每天都来，而且每次都带了更多朋友。
看到他们对中国茶如此感兴趣，吴女士发起了一项名为“茶文化星期六”的每周活动。
她向外国友人展示如何用传统方法泡茶，从选择水温到遵循制茶规则。
她的女儿莉莉是一名大学生，负责帮忙翻译。
不久，她的茶馆总是挤满了游客，包括来自许多地方的学生和商务人士。
“我过去以为外国人不会理解我们的茶文化，但他们非常热爱它。”
“他们中的一些人甚至在家里用中国茶招待朋友，”吴女士说。
她最喜欢的时刻之一是，加拿大女孩莎拉送给了她一本写满了中英文茶艺笔记的笔记本。
“这就是我坚持教学的原因，”吴女士展示着这本珍贵的笔记本说道。
现在，她的茶馆出现在旅游指南中，被称为“苏州的文化会客厅”。
对游客而言，端上的每一杯茶都是了解这座古城茶文化的一扇窗户。

sections.title: Passage F - Tony's Model Plane Dream
raw_text: Tony is a 15-year-old boy.
He 1. ________ (make) seven model planes since two years ago.
Today is Sunday.
Tony is doing his homework now.
After that, he will throw himself into the work of making model 2. ________ (plane) right away.
Last month, Tony made a model plane on 3. ________ (he) own.
He flew it 4. ________ (successful).
His model plane is 0.8 meters wide 5. ________ weighs about 35 kilograms.
This is the 6. ________ (large) one he has ever made and he thinks it the most wonderful one.
When he was making the plane, Tony 7. ________ (meet) many difficulties.
"But the biggest difficulty is that the people around me couldn't understand me well," Tony said.
"When I said I was going to make a model plane, many people thought it was impossible.
But I decided 8. ________ (keep) on working hard.
That is because once I start something, giving up is not 9. ________ choice for me." A model plane competition was held in his town 10. ________ May 1st, 2024. He won first place.
When talking about his future, he said he dreamed of becoming a plane engineer.

questions.explanation: 由时间状语 since two years ago 可知用现在完成时，主语 He 用 has made。
questions.rule_summary: since + 过去时间点 = 现在完成时 have/has + done。

questions.explanation: 制作航模飞机（复数泛指类别），plane 用复数形式 planes。
questions.rule_summary: 可数名词泛指类别用复数 planes。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词性物主代词 (on one's own)
questions.explanation: 固定短语 on one's own 意为'独自，靠自己'，Tony 对应 his own。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 on one's own。

questions.explanation: 修饰动词 flew 需用副词 successfully 意为'成功地'。
questions.rule_summary: 副词修饰动词 v. + adv.

questions.explanation: is 0.8 meters wide 与 weighs 35 kilograms 是并列描述飞机的两个特征，用 and 连接。
questions.rule_summary: 并列谓语顺接用 and。

questions.explanation: the + 最高级 + (that) he has ever made 结构，表示'他制作过的最大的一个'，故填 largest。
questions.rule_summary: the + 最高级 + 完成时定语从句。

questions.explanation: 时间状语从句 was making 为过去进行时，主句描述过去遇到的困难用一般过去时 met。
questions.rule_summary: 过去时间语境用一般过去时 met。

questions.explanation: 固定短语 decide to do sth. 意为'决定做某事'，接不定式 to keep。
questions.rule_summary: decide to do 不定式结构。

questions.explanation: choice 为辅音音素开头的单数可数名词，not a choice 意为'不是一个选择'，填 a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指用 a。

questions.explanation: 具体某一天（2024年5月1日）前用介词 on。
questions.rule_summary: 具体日期前用介词 on。

filled_text: Tony is a 15-year-old boy.
He has made seven model planes since two years ago.
Today is Sunday.
Tony is doing his homework now.
After that, he will throw himself into the work of making model planes right away.
Last month, Tony made a model plane on his own.
He flew it successfully.
His model plane is 0.8 meters wide and weighs about 35 kilograms.
This is the largest one he has ever made and he thinks it the most wonderful one.
When he was making the plane, Tony met many difficulties.
"But the biggest difficulty is that the people around me couldn't understand me well," Tony said.
"When I said I was going to make a model plane, many people thought it was impossible.
But I decided to keep on working hard.
That is because once I start something, giving up is not a choice for me." A model plane competition was held in his town on May 1st, 2024. He won first place.
When talking about his future, he said he dreamed of becoming a plane engineer.
filled_text_cn: 托尼是一个15岁的男孩。
自两年前以来，他已经制作了七架飞机模型。
今天是星期天。
托尼现在正在做作业。
在那之后，他将立刻投入到制作飞机模型的工作中。
上个月，托尼独立制作了一架飞机模型。
他成功地试飞了它。
他的飞机模型有0.8米宽，重约35公斤。
这是他做过的最大的一架，他认为这是最棒的一架。
在制作这架飞机时，托尼遇到了许多困难。
“但最大的困难是周围的人不能很好地理解我，”托尼说。
“当我说明我要制作一架飞机模型时，许多人认为这是不可能的。
但我决定继续努力。
那是因为一旦我开始做某事，放弃对我就不是一个选项。” 2024年5月1日，他的镇上举办了一场飞机模型比赛。他获得了第一名。
当谈到他的未来时，他说他梦想成为一名飞机工程师。

sections.title: Passage G - The Secret of Happiness
raw_text: Once upon a time, there was a rich man.
He loved his son very much.
1. ________ he wanted to make his son have a happy life, he decided to send him 2. ________ (see) a smart old man for advice on how to live a happy life.
When the old man knew about this, he gave the boy 3. ________ empty bowl and asked him to go to the river and fill the bowl 4. ________ water.
"If no water is spilt (洒) when you come back, I 5. ________ (tell) you about it." The boy walked to the river and came back with a bowl of water.

The old man asked him, "Did you notice the beautiful flowers along the road and the birds singing in the trees?" The boy could say nothing about them because he 6. ________ (pay) much attention to the bowl in his hands.
The old man smiled and said, "Bring me another bowl of water.
On the way, enjoy 7. ________ (you) and enjoy the flowers and the singing of birds." When he came back, the boy could describe everything he had seen to the old man.
But when he looked at his bowl, he found most water was 8. ________.
When he enjoyed the beautiful things along the road, he forgot 9. ________ (care) about his bowl.
"Well, young man," the old man said.
"This is the secret of 10. ________ (happy): Enjoy the beauty of the world, but never forget your dream in your heart."

questions.explanation: 引导原因状语从句'因为他想让儿子过得幸福'，故填 Because（或 As）。
questions.rule_summary: 原因状语从句连词 Because。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：send sb. to do
questions.explanation: send sb. to do sth. 派遣某人去做某事，不定式 to see 作目的状语。
questions.rule_summary: send sb. to do sth. 不定式结构。

questions.explanation: empty 以元音音素开头，泛指'一只空碗'，用不定冠词 an。
questions.rule_summary: 元音音素前泛指单数名词用 an。

questions.explanation: 固定短语 fill...with... 意为'用……装满……'，故填介词 with。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 fill...with...

questions.explanation: if 引导的条件状语从句使用一般现在时 (is spilt)，主句需用一般将来时 will tell。
questions.rule_summary: 主将从现原则：条件状语从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时。

questions.explanation: 主句 could say 为过去时，叙述走在路上时的动作，pay attention to 过去式为 paid。
questions.rule_summary: 一般过去时 paid。

questions.explanation: 祈使句省略主语 you，固定短语 enjoy oneself 意为'玩得开心'，对单个人说用 yourself。
questions.rule_summary: enjoy yourself 固定搭配。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词作表语 (gone 表消失/不见)
questions.explanation: was gone 意为'水都洒光了/不见了'，gone 作形容词表语，故填 gone。
questions.rule_summary: be gone 表示'没了/不见了'。

questions.explanation: forget to do sth. 忘记去做某事（忘记顾及手中的碗），接不定式 to care。
questions.rule_summary: forget to do sth. 忘记去做某事。

questions.explanation: 介词 of 后接名词，happy 的名词形式变 y 为 i 加 ness -> happiness。
questions.rule_summary: 介词 of + 派生名词 happiness。

filled_text: Once upon a time, there was a rich man.
He loved his son very much.
Because he wanted to make his son have a happy life, he decided to send him to see a smart old man for advice on how to live a happy life.
When the old man knew about this, he gave the boy an empty bowl and asked him to go to the river and fill the bowl with water.
"If no water is spilt when you come back, I will tell you about it." The boy walked to the river and came back with a bowl of water.

The old man asked him, "Did you notice the beautiful flowers along the road and the birds singing in the trees?" The boy could say nothing about them because he paid much attention to the bowl in his hands.
The old man smiled and said, "Bring me another bowl of water.
On the way, enjoy yourself and enjoy the flowers and the singing of birds." When he came back, the boy could describe everything he had seen to the old man.
But when he looked at his bowl, he found most water was gone.
When he enjoyed the beautiful things along the road, he forgot to care about his bowl.
"Well, young man," the old man said.
"This is the secret of happiness: Enjoy the beauty of the world, but never forget your dream in your heart."
filled_text_cn: 从前，有一个富人。
他非常爱自己的儿子。
为了让儿子过上幸福的生活，他决定送儿子去向一位充满智慧的老人请教如何过上幸福的生活。
老人得知此事后，给了男孩一个空碗，并让他去河边把碗装满水。
“如果你回来时一滴水也没洒，我就告诉你答案。”男孩走到河边，端着一碗水回来了。
老人问他：“你注意到沿途美丽的花朵和树上唱歌的鸟儿了吗？”男孩对此一无所知，因为他把全部注意力都放在了手里的碗上。
老人微笑着说：“再给我端一碗水来。”
“在路上，要好好享受，欣赏花朵和鸟儿的歌唱。”当他回来时，男孩能向老人描述他看到的一切。
但是当他看自己的碗时，发现大部分水都已经不见了。
当他欣赏沿途的美景时，却忘了照顾好自己的碗。
“好吧，年轻人，”老人说。
“这就是幸福的秘密：享受世界的美丽，但永远不要忘记你心中的梦想。”

sections.title: Passage H - The Mother River Huanghe
raw_text: The Yellow River runs from the mountains 1. ________ the sea.
It gave birth to one of 2. ________ oldest and most famous cultures in the world—the Yellow River culture.
In the hearts of 3. ________ (China) people, the Yellow River is the mother river.
It is expected to play a more important role in our country's 4. ________ (develop).
The river got its name Huanghe 5. ________ its water is yellow, as it took lots of yellow sand to the water when it ran through the Loess Plateau(黄土高原).
The river starts from Qinghai Province in northwestern China.
It runs through a lot of places before 6. ________ (run) into the Bohai Sea.
The river feeds about 12% of China's population and provides water for about 17% of the fields and more than 60 7. ________ (city).
So far, our country 8. ________ (make) great efforts in the environmental protection of the river.
Each year over 400 million tons of sand 9. ________ (prevent) from being washed into it.
Our mother river has become much 10. ________ (clear) than before.

questions.explanation: 固定结构 from...to... 意为'从……到……'，故填 to。
questions.rule_summary: 固定介词搭配 from...to...

questions.explanation: one of the + 形容词最高级 (oldest)，最高级前必须用定冠词 the。
questions.rule_summary: one of the + 最高级。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词 people 需用形容词 Chinese 表示'中国人民'。
questions.rule_summary: 国名转化为国家/民族形容词 Chinese。

questions.explanation: 名词所有格 country's 后接名词，develop 加后缀 -ment 变为 development。
questions.rule_summary: 名词所有格后接派生名词 development。

questions.explanation: 引导原因状语从句'因为它的水是黄色的'，故填连词 because。
questions.rule_summary: 原因状语从句连接词 because。

questions.explanation: before 此处为介词，后接动名词形式，run 双写 n 加 ing -> running。
questions.rule_summary: 介词 + doing 动名词。

questions.explanation: 60 后面接可数名词复数，city 变 y 为 i 再加 es -> cities。
questions.rule_summary: 基数词 (>1) + 名词复数 cities。

questions.grammar_point_name: 现在完成时 (So far标志词)
questions.explanation: So far 意为'到目前为止'，是现在完成时的标志词，our country 是单数，用 has made。
questions.rule_summary: so far + 现在完成时 (has/have done)。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般现在时的被动语态
questions.explanation: 主语是 sand（不可数名词），动作每年发生，sand 与 prevent 是被动关系，故用 is prevented。
questions.rule_summary: 不可数名词主语 + 被动语态 is done。

questions.explanation: 句中有 than before 且有 much 修饰，clear 的比较级为 clearer。
questions.rule_summary: much + 比较级 + than before。

filled_text: The Yellow River runs from the mountains to the sea.
It gave birth to one of the oldest and most famous cultures in the world—the Yellow River culture.
In the hearts of Chinese people, the Yellow River is the mother river.
It is expected to play a more important role in our country's development.
The river got its name Huanghe because its water is yellow, as it took lots of yellow sand to the water when it ran through the Loess Plateau.
The river starts from Qinghai Province in northwestern China.
It runs through a lot of places before running into the Bohai Sea.
The river feeds about 12% of China's population and provides water for about 17% of the fields and more than 60 cities.
So far, our country has made great efforts in the environmental protection of the river.
Each year over 400 million tons of sand is prevented from being washed into it.
Our mother river has become much clearer than before.
filled_text_cn: 黄河从群山奔腾流向大海。
它孕育了世界上最古老、最著名的文化之一——黄河流域文化。
在中国人民心中，黄河是母亲河。
它有望在我国的发展中发挥更重要的作用。
这条河之所以被称为黄河，是因为它的水是黄色的，当它流经黄土高原时，带走了大量的黄沙。
这条河发源于中国西北部的青海省。
它流经许多地方，最后注入渤海。
黄河养育了中国约12%的人口，为约17%的农田和60多座城市提供了水源。
到目前为止，我国为该河流的环境保护做出了巨大努力。
每年有超过4亿吨的泥沙被阻止冲入河中。
我们的母亲河比以前清澈多了。

sections.title: Passage I - The Color Red in China
raw_text: Red is a national colour in China.
It has 1. ________ (deep) influenced Chinese culture and traditions.
People use it a lot, from celebrations and festivals to daily life.
The use of red dates back to ancient times.
During the Han Dynasty, red showed 2. ________ important someone was.
And people often used it when they got 3. ________ (marry) or in other celebrations.
In the Tang Dynasty, red 4. ________ (become) a popular colour for clothing.
In Chinese culture, red is a special colour.
It means a lot of good things and feelings.
It's a colour of joy and good luck.
People use it to bring happiness and drive bad things away.
It's common 5. ________ (see) it at weddings, on birthdays, and during the Chinese New Year.
It's a colour of wealth and health.
People often wear 6. ________ carry something red.
It's also a colour of power and energy.
Today, red continues to play 7. ________ important role in Chinese culture and society.
The National Flag of the People's Republic of China is red 8. ________ five yellow stars.
And now, red is a hot colour in fashion.
More and more people choose to wear traditional wedding 9. ________ (dress) at weddings.
Red also 10. ________ (appear) in phrases.
For example, "mianhong erchi" stands for being angry.

questions.explanation: 修饰动词 influenced 需用副词 deeply 意为'深刻地'。
questions.rule_summary: 副词修饰动词 has + adv. + done。

questions.explanation: 引导宾语从句修饰形容词 important，how important someone was 表示'某人有多么重要'。
questions.rule_summary: how + adj. 引导宾语从句感叹/程度结构。

questions.explanation: 固定短语 get married 意为'结婚'，故填 married。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 get married。

questions.explanation: In the Tang Dynasty 是明确的过去时间状语，become 的过去式为 became。
questions.rule_summary: 过去历史朝代时间对应一般过去时 became。

questions.grammar_point_name: 句型 It is common to do sth.
questions.explanation: It is + adj. + to do sth. 句型中 It 为形式主语，真正的主语为动词不定式 to see。
questions.rule_summary: It is adj. to do sth. 形式主语句型。

questions.explanation: wear 或 carry 是选择关系，'穿戴或者携带红色物品'，故填连词 or。
questions.rule_summary: 并列选择关系连词 or。

questions.explanation: 固定短语 play an important role in... 意为'在……中起重要作用'，important 以元音音素开头，填 an。
questions.rule_summary: play an important role in 固定短语。

questions.explanation: 介词 with 意为'带有，具有'，表示'带有五颗黄星的红旗'，故填 with。
questions.rule_summary: 介词 with 表示伴随/带有特征。

questions.explanation: dress 作可数名词意为'礼服/服装'，此处泛指 wedding dresses（结婚礼服），复数加 es -> dresses。
questions.rule_summary: 可数名词泛指复数 dresses。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般现在时（主谓一致第三人称单数）
questions.explanation: 陈述现代语言中的客观现象用一般现在时，主语 Red（红色）为不可数/单数，动词加 s -> appears。
questions.rule_summary: 单数主语 + 一般现在时 = 动词三单 appears。

filled_text: Red is a national colour in China.
It has deeply influenced Chinese culture and traditions.
People use it a lot, from celebrations and festivals to daily life.
The use of red dates back to ancient times.
During the Han Dynasty, red showed how important someone was.
And people often used it when they got married or in other celebrations.
In the Tang Dynasty, red became a popular colour for clothing.
In Chinese culture, red is a special colour.
It means a lot of good things and feelings.
It's a colour of joy and good luck.
People use it to bring happiness and drive bad things away.
It's common to see it at weddings, on birthdays, and during the Chinese New Year.
It's a colour of wealth and health.
People often wear or carry something red.
It's also a colour of power and energy.
Today, red continues to play an important role in Chinese culture and society.
The National Flag of the People's Republic of China is red with five yellow stars.
And now, red is a hot colour in fashion.
More and more people choose to wear traditional wedding dresses at weddings.
Red also appears in phrases.
For example, "mianhong erchi" stands for being angry.
filled_text_cn: 红色是中国的一个国家代表色。
它对中国文化和传统产生了深远的影响。
人们经常使用它，从庆祝活动、节日到日常生活。
红色的使用可以追溯到古代。
在汉代，红色显示了一个人地位有多重要。
而且人们在结婚或其他庆祝活动时经常使用它。
在唐代，红色成为了服装的流行色。
在中国文化中，红色是一种特殊的颜色。
它意味着许多美好的事物和情感。
它是一种代表欢乐和好运的颜色。
人们用它来带来幸福并驱赶不好的东西。
在婚礼、生日和中国农历新年期间，看到它是很常见的。
它是一种代表财富和健康的颜色。
人们经常穿着或随身携带红色的东西。
它也是一种代表权力和能量的颜色。
今天，红色在中国的文化和社会中继续发挥着重要的作用。
中华人民共和国国旗是红色的，上面有五颗黄色星星。
而现在，红色是时尚界的热门颜色。
越来越多的人选择在婚礼上穿传统的中式婚礼服。
红色也出现在习语中。
例如，“面红耳赤”代表生气。

sections.title: Passage J - Snakes in Chinese Culture
raw_text: The year 2025 is the Year of the Snake.
The snake is 1. ________ sixth of the twelve Chinese zodiac(生肖) animals.
In the west, the snake is seen as an evil(邪恶的) animal or a positive animal sometimes.
In Chinese culture, however, it is seen in a 2. ________ (positive) light(角度) than in the west.
In China, the snake is often called the small dragon.
The 3. ________ (dragon) body is that of a big snake.
For this reason, many people believe that the image(形象) of the dragon came from the snake.
Snakes can be seen in many old Chinese 4. ________ (story).
In Chinese mythology(神话), Fu Xi was one of the ancestors(祖先) of the Chinese people.
5. ________ his younger sister Nü Wa created humans from earth.
Both of 6. ________ (they) had snake bodies and human heads.
There are lots of stories about gods and goddesses in *Shanhaijing*.
Many of them had something 7. ________ (do) with snakes.
For example, the four gods of the sea all 8. ________ (wear) snakes as earrings and they also traveled on snakes.
Snakes have shown up in many folk stories, too.
One famous story is called *Baishe Zhuan* or *The Legend of the White Snake*.
In this story, a magical snake named Bai Suzhen falls 9. ________ love with a man named Xu Xian.
Bai Suzhen 10. ________ (picture) as a kind and beautiful character.
Yes.
Do you remember "Bai Suzhen" has been in this year's Spring Festival Gala?

questions.explanation: sixth 为序数词，序数词前需加定冠词 the，表示'第……个'。
questions.rule_summary: 序数词前用定冠词 the。

questions.explanation: 句中有比较标志词 than in the west，positive 为多音节形容词，比较级前加 more -> more positive。
questions.rule_summary: 多音节形容词比较级 more + adj.

questions.explanation: 修饰名词 body 意为'龙的身体'，用名词所有格 dragon's。
questions.rule_summary: 单数名词所有格 's。

questions.explanation: many 修饰可数名词复数，story 变 y 为 i 加 es -> stories。
questions.rule_summary: many + 可数名词复数 stories。

questions.explanation: 顺接前文叙述伏羲和女娲的并列关系，用并列连词 And（首字母大写）。
questions.rule_summary: 句首顺接连词 And。

questions.explanation: 介词 of 后面需用代词宾格形式，both of them 意为'他们两人都……'，故填 them。
questions.rule_summary: 介词后接人称代词宾格 them。

questions.grammar_point_name: 固定搭配 (have something to do with)
questions.explanation: 固定短语 have something to do with 意为'与……有关'，故填不定式 to do。
questions.rule_summary: have something to do with 固定短语。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般过去时（不规则动词变化）
questions.explanation: 与后半句 traveled 并列，叙述神话传说中的动作，wear 的过去式为 wore。
questions.rule_summary: 一般过去时 wore 与 traveled 并列。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定短语 (fall in love with)
questions.explanation: 固定短语 fall in love with sb. 意为'爱上某人'，故填介词 in。
questions.rule_summary: fall in love with 固定短语。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般现在时的被动语态
questions.explanation: 主语 Bai Suzhen 与 picture（描绘/刻画）是被动关系，且陈述故事中人物一贯的形象，用一般现在时被动语态 is pictured。
questions.rule_summary: 文学人物形象描述 + 单数被动 = is pictured as。

filled_text: The year 2025 is the Year of the Snake.
The snake is the sixth of the twelve Chinese zodiac animals.
In the west, the snake is seen as an evil animal or a positive animal sometimes.
In Chinese culture, however, it is seen in a more positive light than in the west.
In China, the snake is often called the small dragon.
The dragon's body is that of a big snake.
For this reason, many people believe that the image of the dragon came from the snake.
Snakes can be seen in many old Chinese stories.
In Chinese mythology, Fu Xi was one of the ancestors of the Chinese people.
And his younger sister Nü Wa created humans from earth.
Both of them had snake bodies and human heads.
There are lots of stories about gods and goddesses in *Shanhaijing*.
Many of them had something to do with snakes.
For example, the four gods of the sea all wore snakes as earrings and they also traveled on snakes.
Snakes have shown up in many folk stories, too.
One famous story is called *Baishe Zhuan* or *The Legend of the White Snake*.
In this story, a magical snake named Bai Suzhen falls in love with a man named Xu Xian.
Bai Suzhen is pictured as a kind and beautiful character.
Yes.
Do you remember "Bai Suzhen" has been in this year's Spring Festival Gala?
filled_text_cn: 2025年是蛇年。
蛇是中国十二生肖中的第六个动物。
在西方，蛇有时被视为一种邪恶的动物，有时也被视为积极的动物。
然而，在中国文化中，人们看待蛇的角度比在西方更积极。
在中国，蛇经常被称为小龙。
龙的身体就是大蛇的身体。
正因如此，许多人认为龙的形象来源于蛇。
在许多中国古代故事中都能看到蛇的身影。
在中国神话中，伏羲是中华民族的祖先之一。
他的妹妹女娲用泥土创造了人类。
他们两个都拥有蛇的身体和人的头部。
《山海经》里有很多关于神仙的故事。
其中许多故事都与蛇有关。
例如，四位海神都把蛇当作耳环，并且他们还乘蛇出行。
蛇也出现在许多民间故事中。
一个著名的故事叫作《白蛇传》。
在这个故事里，一条名叫白素贞的会法术的蛇爱上了一个名叫许仙的男子。
白素贞被刻画成一个善良美丽的性格。
是的。
你还记得“白素贞”曾出现在今年的春节联欢晚会上吗？
